description: Defines the class 'complex_exponential_table' which provides methods to generate and sample complex exponential (sinusoid) tables for signal processing.

classes.name: complex_exponential_table
classes.description: A class that creates and manipulates a table of complex exponentials for signal processing applications.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the complex exponential table.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a specific coefficient from the table with bounds checking.

methods.name: generate (span<cf_t> out, std::size_t initial, std::size_t frequency)
methods.description: Generates a complex sinusoid sequence based on the table, starting at 'initial' and with a given 'frequency'.

methods.name: generate (span<cf_t> out, span<const unsigned> in)
methods.description: Samples the table at unsigned indices to produce an output sequence.

methods.name: generate (span<cf_t> out, span<const int> in)
methods.description: Samples the table at signed indices, handling negative indices via modulo.
